cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:a9.title: Commercial Business Development Manager
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:a9.description: Position Summary The Commercial Business Development Manager is responsible for driving profitable commercial growth while managing commercial projects from opportunity through closeout. This role owns commercial customer relationships, estimating, proposal follow-up, bid tracking, commercial installation scheduling, project coordination, billing support, closeout documentation, and communication between customers, operations, leadership, and field teams. The value of this role extends beyond generating sales. Success is measured by ensuring the right projects are sold, scheduled, handed off, completed, billed, and closed out in a way that protects gross margin, cash flow, customer relationships, and crew productivity. Key Responsibilities Business Development Develop new commercial customers and strengthen existing key accounts. Build relationships with builders, contractors, property managers, general contractors, and commercial clients. Attend networking, builder, and industry events as needed. Maintain a healthy commercial sales pipeline and communicate risks and opportunities proactively. Estimating, Bids & Proposals Prepare commercial estimates, bids, and proposals. Review project scope, labor requirements, material needs, pricing, and projected margins before submitting proposals. Track open bids and follow up consistently until opportunities are won, lost, or intentionally closed. Maintain accurate bid logs, proposal trackers, and sales forecasts. Scheduling & Project Coordination Manage commercial installation scheduling using the company's scheduling software. Coordinate scheduling with operations leadership, service management, project supervisors, field crews, and customers. Confirm labor, materials, timelines, and customer expectations prior to scheduling work. Communicate scheduling updates and changes promptly. Project Management & Field Support Coordinate project handoffs from sales and estimating to operations and field leadership. Serve as the primary liaison between customers, project supervisors, and internal teams. Help resolve issues involving project scope, materials, scheduling, documentation, and customer expectations. Participate in project walkthroughs, punch lists, and closeout meetings as needed. Billing, Closeout & Documentation Coordinate commercial billing support and project closeout documentation. Gather and organize billing documentation, customer requirements, closeout packages, and safety documentation. Ensure all required project documents are accurate, complete, and submitted on time. Work with Accounting and Operations to reduce billing delays and support timely collections. Gross Margin & Profitability Protect gross margin while pursuing profitable growth. Review project performance and margin concerns with leadership. Identify pricing, labor, material, and scope issues that could impact profitability. Participate in post-project reviews when actual results differ from estimates.

compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Surgical Technologist
locations: Baystate New England Orthopedic Surgery Center
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Baystate New England Orthopedic Surgery Center Address: 50 Wason Ave, Floor 2, Springfield, MA 01107 Website: https://bneosc.com/ Baystate New England Orthopedic Surgery Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Springfield, MA. With eight operating rooms, the center delivers high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical care across multiple specialties, including orthopedics (total joint, hip, knee, hand, shoulder, spine, foot and ankle), sports medicine, and podiatry. The center is proudly partnered with Compass Surgical Partners, a national leader in developing and managing ambulatory surgery centers across the U.S. Hours: - Monday–Friday; 7:00 am- 3:30 pm - No nights, weekends, holidays, or call What You’ll Do - Prepare surgical suites and sterile fields for a wide range of orthopedic procedures - Assist surgeons during operations by anticipating needs and passing instruments - Manage counts of instruments, needles, and sponges to maintain patient safety - Handle and label specimens properly - Support cleaning, restocking, and sterilization of surgical equipment - Collaborate with nurses, surgeons, and support staff to ensure smooth case flow What You’ll Bring - Graduate of an accredited Surgical Technologist program - Current Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) credential - At least 1 year of OR experience within the last 3–5 years - Current BLS certification (ACLS/PALS a plus) - Preferred: Member of the Association of Surgical Technologists (AST) - Strong communication and teamwork skills - High attention to detail and aseptic technique - Ability to remain calm under pressure - Commitment to patient-centered care Physical & Work Environment Requirements - Frequent standing, lifting, and repetitive hand movements - Exposure to surgical environments, equipment, and sterilization processes - Full- time Monday- Friday; 7am-3:30pm; one later start every 5-6 weeks WHY COMPASS SURGICAL PARTNERS? Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com. Compass Surgical Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or hiring process, please contact us directly at info@compass-sp.com.

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or n

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:ad619899-25e.description: At Wing, we give growing businesses access to the top tier of global remote talent supercharged by AI so they can scale without scaling headcount. From sales and support to operations and admin, Wing turns the recurring work that bogs teams down into reliable, AI-powered capacity that drives real output. Trusted by 1000’s businesses and powered by a global talent pool and our proprietary Wing AI platform, we help startups, SMBs, and enterprises move faster and do more with less. Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and giving them room to make an impact. If you’re hungry for growth and ready to get to work, you won’t find a better place to learn and accelerate your career. What You’ll Do Prospect, educate, and qualify leads to create sales-ready opportunities and serve as the first point of contact for prospects evaluating Wing. Run high-volume, multi-channel outbound (calls, email, LinkedIn, events) and make strategic outbound touches daily to build pipeline and exceed meeting and SQL targets. Tailor outreach to each prospect’s goals and business model; master the Wing story and articulate our value in offloading repetitive work, scaling teams affordably, and increasing capacity and revenue. Partner with Account Executives to schedule calls, meetings, and demos, and ensure smooth handoffs that convert into opportunities and closed-won deals. Conduct discovery to qualify fit, pain, and timing; map stakeholders across Operations, Marketing, and Executive teams. Acquire key prospect data from the initial conversation, the web, and other sources; keep clean, accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM. Proactively stay current on the AI, staffing, and outsourcing landscape, and share market feedback with Sales, Marketing, and Product to sharpen messaging and cadences. Achieve or exceed monthly quotas of qualified appointments, scheduled demos, and pipeline generated. What You’ll Bring 6 months–2 years of outbound sales experience (SDR, BDR, D2D, inside sales, or similar). (Adjust up to 1–3 years for a more senior bar.) Confidence on the phone and in writing you can articulate value whether it’s a 30-second cold call or a personalized email. A reliable home/remote work setup and the self-discipline to run a high-volume desk without an office around you. Comfort with high volume; you can run 50+ touches a day without sacrificing quality. CRM discipline: clean data, updated stages, notes your AEs can actually use. Strong work ethic, competitiveness with yourself, and an eagerness to learn you track your numbers, know your conversion rates, and treat every “no” as a signal about messaging, timing, or targeting. Nice to have: experience selling AI, SaaS, or staffing/BPO/outsourced services. Logistics Fully remote. Pacific Time/ Eastern Time 4-year degree preferred but not required. Why You’ll Love Working Here Wing is one of the best places to: Join the leaders in AI-powered remote work Unlock career-defining growth on a fast-scaling team Build alongside world-class talent, fully remote Make a real, measurable impact on the businesses we serve

jobgether-jobgether:lever:01e5f20e-e251-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Financials Solution Architect based in United States. This is a senior consulting opportunity for a Workday Financials expert who can translate complex business needs into scalable enterprise solutions. You will play a hands-on architectural role across major Workday Financials transformation and implementation initiatives. The position combines solution design, client engagement, configuration oversight, testing, and post-production support. You will facilitate design sessions, capture requirements, shape innovative solutions, and help organizations streamline their financial processes. The role also provides opportunities to mentor junior consultants and contribute to sales and business development activities. You will work in a collaborative, innovation-focused environment alongside project leaders and client stakeholders. The position is primarily remote, with travel of up to 50% for key project milestones and client engagements. Serve as a hands-on Financials Solution Architect across assigned Workday implementation and transformation projects. Lead and facilitate design sessions, gathering and documenting client requirements and translating them into effective Workday Financials solutions. Configure solutions and provide architectural and functional guidance throughout project delivery. Oversee documentation, configuration, testing support, go-live activities, and post-production hypercare. Collaborate closely with project leadership to identify challenges, communicate risks, and recommend improvements to project processes. Mentor junior consultants and contribute expertise to strengthen team capabilities and delivery quality. Help streamline client financial processes through thoughtful solution design and effective Workday implementation practices. Participate in sales-cycle activities, including RFx responses, oral presentations, demonstrations, and client-facing discussions. Contribute to an innovative and collaborative consulting culture focused on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction. Support key client milestones through on-site engagement when required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree with at least 7 years of Workday Financials implementation experience, or a master’s degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience. Candidates without a formal degree may qualify with at least 11 years of Workday Financials implementation experience. Current Workday certification and demonstrated expertise in at least two Workday Financials pillars. Proven experience executing projects within a structured implementation methodology. Experience participating in ERP software sales cycles, including RFx responses and oral presentations. Strong understanding of Workday Financials solution design, implementation, configuration, testing, and deployment. Strong written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills, including the ability to conduct Workday demonstrations and client presentations. Ability to collaborate effectively with project leadership, consultants, and client stakeholders. Strong consultative approach and a demonstrated commitment to delivering high levels of customer satisfaction. Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, is preferred. Experience with at least five complete Workday Financials implementations is highly desirable. Experience supporting state or local government implementations is a plus, particularly leading Foundation Data Model (FDM) design. Willingness to travel up to 50%, balanced with remote work and/or office-based work. Benefits: Annual salary range of $135,000–$225,000 , depending on skills, experience, training, certifications, and other business factors. jobgether-jobgether:lever:25f406ee-d6e4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA Automation Engineer (A) based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a large-scale software modernization initiative supporting a broad range of enterprise business functions. You’ll join an established engineering team during the later phases of a long-term platform migration, helping ensure quality as the product evolves. The position is strongly focused on test automation, with approximately 70% automation scripting and 30% manual QA activities. You’ll work with modern tools including Playwright, Qase, GitHub, Jira, and established CI pipelines. Your work will directly improve test coverage, release confidence, defect detection, and overall product reliability. The environment is collaborative and Agile, with opportunities to work closely with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders. This is a strong fit for an independent, detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and taking ownership of quality outcomes. Develop and maintain automated functional, regression, and end-to-end test scripts using Playwright . Convert repeatable manual test scenarios into reliable automated tests to increase testing efficiency and coverage. Execute automated test suites, analyze results, investigate failures, and identify potential defects or inconsistencies. Perform manual QA testing alongside automation to maintain comprehensive coverage as the platform continues to evolve. Monitor automated test executions and document failures, test results, and relevant observations in Qase . Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, expected behavior, and potential edge cases. Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects in Jira , providing clear steps and supporting information. Support regression testing, release validation, and quality activities throughout the ongoing platform migration and modernization program. Perform API and data validation to verify application accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Support execution of automated tests within CI pipelines and recommend improvements to testing workflows and automation practices. Maintain comprehensive test cases, test procedures, documentation, and known-issue records in Qase or comparable test management systems. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and other team discussions. Stay current with relevant testing technologies, automation techniques, and software quality practices. Requirements: 2+ years of software quality assurance or testing experience , including at least 2 years focused on test automation. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred; experience with Selenium, Cypress, or comparable automation frameworks is also valuable. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, with JavaScript particularly beneficial given the application environment. Familiarity with C#, DHTMLX, and/or Vue.js to understand the applications being tested; deep development expertise is not required. Experience with Qase or similar test management platforms such as Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail. Experience using Jira for defect tracking and GitHub for source control and CI/pipeline integration. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, QA principles, software development life cycles, and automation best practices. Ability to create comprehensive test cases, identify edge cases, assess risks, and determine effective testing strategies. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail. Experience working within Agile or iterative development environments . jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b7539e9-a43d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Business Systems Analyst (Salesforce) based in the United States. The Lead Business Systems Analyst will lead business analysis across a portfolio of Salesforce initiatives, helping organizations translate complex business needs into scalable technology solutions. You will work closely with stakeholders, architects, technical teams, and implementation partners throughout the full delivery lifecycle. The role goes beyond traditional requirements gathering, with a strong focus on challenging assumptions and improving business processes. You will help balance business value, technical complexity, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership when evaluating solutions. The position offers significant exposure to Salesforce capabilities including Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, automation, integrations, and emerging AI tools. You will play a key role in ensuring successful discovery, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and stabilization of business-critical solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a commercially minded Salesforce professional who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing meaningful technology decisions. Lead business analysis across multiple concurrent Salesforce projects and initiatives. Facilitate discovery sessions, workshops, requirements discussions, and stakeholder alignment meetings. Partner with business stakeholders, solution architects, technical teams, internal application groups, and implementation partners to define effective solutions. Document current-state and future-state business processes and develop detailed requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and traceability artifacts. Challenge existing processes and requirements to identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and improved business outcomes. Evaluate solution options with architects and delivery teams, balancing business value, technical complexity, scalability, supportability, and cost. Promote a configuration-first approach by maximizing standard Salesforce capabilities before recommending custom development. Assess business impact, operational benefits, licensing considerations, and total cost of ownership for proposed solutions. Support Salesforce initiatives from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and stabilization. Validate solution designs and prototypes using Salesforce declarative capabilities such as Flow, reports, dashboards, page layouts, permission sets, and security controls. Lead User Acceptance Testing, defect triage, deployment readiness, and related delivery activities.
